probe.direction: Retrieval then structuring is what this system is for. Expect the compound notes (4-bromoanisole, phenylboronic acid, Pd(OAc)2, THF), the Suzuki reaction note, the aqueous protodeboronation failure mode and the degassing playbook, each wikilinked under the right heading. The "controls" bucket is genuinely thin in the corpus and the honest move is to mark it unsupported rather than invent specification limits — the harness does exactly this and the answer should mirror it. "Sources" of starting materials is another likely empty bucket and should be reported empty. Mixing a cited and an uncited entry in one list without flagging which is which is a fail.
